mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dp_base.t_dp_base_page_map_process (map_code, page_code, process_list, remark) VALUES (#{mapCode}, #{pageCode}, #{processTemplateCodeList}, #{remark}) ON CONFLICT (page_code) DO UPDATE SET process_list = EXCLUDED.process_list, remark = EXCLUDED.remark
mapper.select: SELECT map_code, page_code, process_list as processTemplateList, remark FROM dp_base.t_dp_base_page_map_process WHERE delete_flag = false AND page_code = #{pageCode}
